description: Roll out a release — this IS Android's publish action for the release. Not simply reversible; always confirm with the user, especially on production. Preconditions it cannot satisfy itself: the release needs an artifact attached (attach_artifact_to_release — promote_release does NOT attach one), and the track needs at least one EXPLICITLY selected country (target_rest_of_world alone is not a selection — see update_track_countries). A bare FAILED_PRECONDITION here names nothing: open the Console's release review page (.../tracks/{track}/releases/{release}/review) and expand its errors, which is read-only and states the cause in one sentence. Production additionally requires the app to have passed review once.

developer_id.description: Numeric Play Console developer id (from the Play Console URL).

google_account_email.description: The signed-in Google account email that owns this Play Console developer account. Call list_accounts first and confirm with the user — do not guess.

notification_message.description: Short user-facing sentence for this action if the follow-up reply fails. Plain text only; do not mention template syntax or variable names.

play_app_id.description: Numeric Play app id from the Play Console URL (.../app/<this>/...). NOT the package name.

release_id.description: Release id on this track, from create_release/get_track.

rollout_percentage.description: Percentage of users to roll out to, 0-100. Defaults to 100 (full rollout) if omitted.

target_rest_of_world.description: "true" serves every country/region Play allows; "false" serves only targeted_countries. Omitted is NOT the same as "false" — it keeps whatever the track already targets. Same caveat as targeted_countries: it cannot stand in for update_track_countries on an untargeted track.

targeted_countries.description: Comma-separated ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 codes, e.g. "NG,GH,KE". NOTE: on a track that has no country targeting of its own this does NOT work — tested live, Play still refuses. Use update_track_countries to set the track's countries first; this parameter only narrows a rollout on a track that is already targeted. Nothing is defaulted — ask the user.

track_id.description: Numeric track id (e.g. the long digits in the Play Console URL's .../tracks/<this>/..., not the human alias like "internal"). Call list_tracks first to find it.

name: start_rollout
